title: Expose reusable update and delete commands
description: Complete wtp reusable with update NAME_OR_ID and delete NAME_OR_ID. Update accepts optional --name, --title, and --instructions, requires at least one supplied field, distinguishes omission from an explicit empty invalid value, and returns the updated definition. Delete performs the provider atomic detach operation and returns {deleted:...,detachedTaskCount:N} in JSON plus a precise human summary. Cover name and UUID selectors, casing-only rename, referenced and unreferenced deletion, completed-task detachment, concurrent/stale provider errors, extra arguments, and no-op updates in CLI tests. Do not add confirmation prompts or force flags; deletion semantics are deliberately detach-everywhere.
